speaker: gauge
text: This microwave screen blocks my view. I'll swap in clear glass.

speaker: fitz
text: Wait. Microwaves pass right through glass. The metal screen keeps them in.

speaker: fitz
text: Tiny holes, about a millimeter. The microwaves in here are about twelve centimeters long. Too big to fit, so the metal bounces them back.

speaker: gauge
text: So how do I see in?

speaker: fitz
text: Light waves are far shorter, so they slip right through. A wall for microwaves, a window for light.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
